paragraphs.text: A MineSweeper Game in Deepseek-Harness
# dsh-mine-sweeper
Minesweeper overlay for DeepSeek Harness. A draggable, collapsible board floats over the left side o
f the conversation area — the empty strip next to the sidebar — so you can play while the agent work
the conversation area — the empty strip next to the sidebar — so you can play while the agent works.

- Custom board: rows and columns 5–30, mine count 1 … rows×cols−9.
- First click is always safe (min

es are planted after it, avoiding the clicked cell and its ring).
- Right-click to flag, `↻` restart

s the same board, `–` collapses to a single 💣 button.
- Losing reveals every mine plus the flags tha

t were wrong; clearing every safe cell wins.
- Nothing is persisted: state lives in React memory and
is gone when you refresh or stop the service.

## How it plugs in
The panel registers into the `shell.overlay` slot (a list slot covering the whole frame), entry id `
sweeper`, order 60. It positions itself absolutely inside that layer, so it never enters the `AppFra
me` grid and never pushes the sidebar, conversation or composer around.
The host half (`index.js`) is intentionally empty: everything lives in the browser bundle (`client.j
s`). `cordis.patch.yml` exists so the package can be installed as a bundle.
## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.1.5-rc.2 < 0.3.0`
- Node.js >= 18
